Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick follow up from procurement: our PO 4512 has been approved but finance needs a slightly different payment cadence than originally discussed. Can you confirm whether Redwood can split the invoice across two remittances (50% now, 50% on 30-Nov) and accept ACH for the first tranche? If ACH is possible we will send bank details and a signed copy of the PO.

Also, we need a W9 to keep on file for our AP system — attaching the PO here. If a wire is easier for Redwood on a short timeline, let me know and we can provide wire details instead.

Attachments: PuebloTech_PO_4512.pdf (pdf)

Action items we have on our side: provide bank info and AP contact to finalize routing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Maria

Subject: Re: PuebloTech PO 4512 & payment timing question

Maria — thanks for the note and for sending the PO. We can do a split remittance as requested. Proposed interim schedule from Redwood:

- 50% (partial settlement) processed within 3 business days of receiving a signed remittance instruction + vendor bank auth
- Remaining 50% processed on 2026-11-30 after final reconciliation with your AP team

To proceed we need:
- ACH details (account + routing) OR wire instructions (bank, account, SWIFT)
- Completed W9 (or equivalent tax doc)
- Bank authorization letter for ACH (for our payments team to keep on file)

Irene from Tax/Finance is looped for the W9/vat residency check — @Irene can you confirm if any additional EU tax/withholding checks are needed (PuebloTech is US-based, but we want to be sure)?

If ACH is provided we will route the first tranche through our standard payments flow. If you prefer to provide wire for speed, note our bank requires >$50k wire pre-notification (we'll confirm cutoff times once we have the routing).

I will prepare an interim invoice (INV-202611-78-part1) and send a DocuSign remittance confirmation once we have the banking info.

Thanks — Hannah
